visum_rule_audit.legal_basis: Flemish Decree on Local Government (DLB) Art. 176, 177, 264-269 / BVR BBC 30 maart 2018 Art. 99
visum_rule_audit.dlb_art_177_rule: DLB Art. 177 establishes Financial Director visum authority; it does NOT create a general EUR 10,000 threshold.
visum_rule_audit.college_override_rule: College may override refused visa under DLB Art. 177 §2, with mandatory immediate notification to Council and Audit Vlaanderen.
visum_rule_audit.debt_collection: Writ of execution (dwangbevel) must be visé'd by Financial Director (DLB Art. 177, 264-269).
